goal: Replace the Cognito contact form with site-styled forms and add an inline sync license request form, with Google Forms (private inbox sheet, email per reply) as the backend.
strategy: One contract (data/forms.json, schema in plan.md section 4) joins three parallel pieces in wave 1: the Apps Script setup that prints it, the shared OZForms core that reads it (plus all shared test harness files), and the docs.
